title: grain/ref@v1: one ranked reference to a task, in a backlog folder (docs/grainfiles.md §6.2)

to.description: The task, wherever it lives (an intake, a Grain repo, or a code repo's grain folder); must resolve, following tombstones, when pushed to a Silo-hosted repo. With fired_at, a trigger instead

fired_at.description: An inline firing (§6.6): to names the trigger, and the task is the trigger rendered for this firing; no task file is written

spec_rev.description: The commit of the task's repo the placement read; the attestation's spec_digest is over the task at this commit

expedite.description: Silo's, on its placements: sorts ahead of every priority band in its own lane (at_front). It never crosses lanes unless the root's lanes.expedite says so (§6.2)

previous.description: On re-placement: the superseded run on the old Grain (§10.7)

attestation.description: Silo's signed claims JWT for this Grain and task (hub.md §6.4, §12.7)
